title: Oriental Plastic Ball
author: Herman Melville
summary: An epic exploration of ancient myths through the lens of modernity, where each chapter reveals a new facet of the human condition.
quotes: The sea is the mirror of the soul, calm on the surface but tormented in its depths.
Destiny is but a plastic ball carried by the winds of the Orient.

title: Tasty Plastic Bike
author: Alan Moore & Dave Gibbons
summary: A dark and visceral graphic novel that deconstructs heroism in a world on the brink of a plastic apocalypse.
quotes: We are all looking at the gutter, but some of them are staring at the plastic stars.
Time is a circle, and this bike has no brakes.

title: Handcrafted Concrete Chicken
author: Isabel Florence Hapgood
summary: In a remote village, a concrete chicken sculpture seems to come to life at night. A folk horror tale about rural superstitions.
quotes: The concrete is cold, but its eyes burned with an ancient glow.
Never turn your back on what has been sculpted in silence.

title: Tasty Bamboo Pants
author: John Bunyan
summary: A terrifying allegory on vanity and consumption, where the clothes we wear eventually end up possessing us.
quotes: The path to perdition is woven into the softest fiber.
Be prepared, for the traveler carries only what he can leave behind.

title: Awesome Concrete Car
author: Victor Hugo
summary: A powerful examination of the industrial revolution and the mechanics of success in 19th-century Paris.
quotes: Nothing stops an idea whose time has come, not even a concrete car.
The future is a door, the past is its key.
